scenes.say: Ever had a service fail to start? Let’s see how systemd fits into the picture.

scenes.label: Unit
scenes.sub: systemd uses unit files to define and control services.
scenes.say: Systemd controls services using unit files. These files describe how your app runs and restarts.

scenes.title: Enable and check your service
scenes.say: Reload systemd, enable your service to run on boot, check its status, and view logs in real time.
System units are in the library folder. Custom units, like your own services, go in the system folder. User units live in your config directory.

scenes.question: Where do you put your own unit files?
scenes.say: Here’s a common interview trap: where should you place your own unit files? Don’t mix them with system units.
